steps.instruction: Verify the workspace: `cd ~/algal-wgs && pixi install --locked && pixi install --locked --offline`
steps.note: Offline re-install passing proves the cache is complete - that is the checkpoint the agent must discuss, not just 'it worked'.

steps.instruction: Create the project skeleton: `mkdir -p data/raw logs && mkdir -p results/{strainA,strainB,strainC,strainD,strainE,strainF}/{qc,kraken2,genomescope,markers,assembly}` (replace strain names with the real six)
steps.note: Silent by design - gate on buffer growth, then require the follow-up 'ls results' to show six strain dirs.

steps.instruction: Copy the data off the pen drive: `cp /path/to/pendrive/*.fq.gz data/raw/ && cp /path/to/pendrive/md5.txt data/raw/` (substitute the real mount path)
steps.note: The accept form is the exercises.md canonical placeholder; the student's real mount path will NOT exactly match, so expect the s6 step-(b) 'ask which command they ran' branch, and gate completion on the follow-up 'ls -lh data/raw' 12-file check. Add the real path as an accept variant once known.
Every line ending OK is the expected outcome; any FAILED routes to the TROUBLESHOOTING.md two-causes discussion, which IS the lesson - not an error branch.
